items.source: Extension of AbstractAdvisingBeanPostProcessor which implements BeanFactoryAware, adds exposure of the original target class for each proxied bean (AutoProxyUtils.ORIGINAL_TARGET_CLASS_ATTRIBUTE), and participates in an externally enforced target-class mode for any given bean (AutoProxyUtils.PRESERVE_TARGET_CLASS_ATTRIBUTE).
items.translation: 扩展了实现 BeanFactoryAware 的 AbstractAdvisingBeanPostProcessor，为每个代理 bean 暴露原始目标类（AutoProxyUtils.ORIGINAL_TARGET_CLASS_ATTRIBUTE），并参与任何给定 bean 的外部强制目标类模式（AutoProxyUtils.PRESERVE_TARGET_CLASS_ATTRIBUTE）。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor that registers AdvisorAdapter beans in the BeanFactory with an AdvisorAdapterRegistry (by default the GlobalAdvisorAdapterRegistry).
items.translation: 注册 `AdvisorAdapter` Bean 的 `BeanPostProcessor`，将其与 `AdvisorAdapterRegistry`（默认情况下为 `GlobalAdvisorAdapterRegistry`）一起注册到 BeanFactory 中。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor implementation that passes the context's default LoadTimeWeaver to beans that implement the LoadTimeWeaverAware interface.
items.translation: 实现该BeanPostProcessor会将上下文的默认LoadTimeWeaver传递给实现LoadTimeWeaverAware接口的 Bean。

items.source: Base class for BeanPostProcessor implementations that apply a Spring AOP Advisor to specific beans.
items.translation: 适用于将 Spring AOPAdvisor 应用于特定 Bean 的 BeanPostProcessor 实现的基础类。

items.source: A BeanPostProcessor that honours ImportAware callback using a mapping computed at build time.
items.translation: 一个在构建时计算映射，以支持使用 `BeanPostProcessor` 的 `ImportAware` 回调。

items.source: Bean post-processor that registers methods annotated with JmsListener to be invoked by a JMS message listener container created under the cover by a JmsListenerContainerFactory according to the attributes of the annotation.
items.translation: 注册带有JmsListener注解的方法，以便由在幕后由JmsListenerContainerFactory创建的 JMS 消息监听器容器根据该注解的属性进行调用。

items.source: A convenient BeanPostProcessor that applies a concurrency interceptor to all bean methods annotated with @ConcurrencyLimit.
items.translation: 一个方便的BeanPostProcessor，它会对所有带有@ConcurrencyLimit注解的 Bean 方法应用并发拦截器。

items.source: A convenient BeanPostProcessor that applies a retry interceptor to all bean methods annotated with @Retryable.
items.translation: 一个方便的BeanPostProcessor，它会对所有带有 @Retryable 注解的 bean 方法应用重试拦截器。

items.source: Bean post-processor that registers methods annotated with @Scheduled to be invoked by a TaskScheduler according to the "fixedRate", "fixedDelay", or "cron" expression provided via the annotation.
items.translation: 注册带有 @Scheduled 注解的方法，以便由 TaskScheduler 根据通过注解提供的 "fixedRate"、"fixedDelay" 或 "cron" 表达式进行调用的 Bean 后置处理器。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor that handles ScriptFactory definitions, replacing each factory with the actual scripted Java object generated by it.
items.translation: 处理 `ScriptFactory` 定义的、用于替换每个工厂由它生成的实际脚本化 Java 对象的`BeanPostProcessor`。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor implementation that passes the ServletContext to beans that implement the ServletContextAware interface.
items.translation: BeanPostProcessor 实现，它将 ServletContext 传递给实现了 ServletContextAware 接口的 Bean。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor implementation that supports common Java annotations out of the box, in particular the common annotations in the jakarta.annotation package.
items.translation: 支持常见 Java 注解的BeanPostProcessor实现，特别是jakarta.annotation包中的常见注解。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor that applies initialization and destruction callbacks to beans that implement the Servlet interface.
items.translation: BeanPostProcessor，该处理器将初始化和销毁回调应用于实现Servlet接口的 Bean。

items.source: AspectJAwareAdvisorAutoProxyCreator subclass that processes all AspectJ annotation aspects in the current application context, as well as Spring Advisors.
items.translation: AspectJAwareAdvisorAutoProxyCreator 子类用于处理当前应用上下文中所有的 AspectJ 注解切面以及 Spring Advisor。

items.source: AbstractAdvisorAutoProxyCreator subclass that exposes AspectJ's invocation context and understands AspectJ's rules for advice precedence when multiple pieces of advice come from the same aspect.
items.translation: AbstractAdvisorAutoProxyCreator 子类，它暴露了 AspectJ 的调用上下文，并理解当多个通知来自同一个切面时 AspectJ 的通知优先级规则。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor implementation that wraps each eligible bean with an AOP proxy, delegating to specified interceptors before invoking the bean itself.
items.translation: 实现`BeanPostProcessor`接口，用 AOP 代理包裹每个符合条件的 Bean，在调用该 Bean 之前委托给指定的拦截器。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor implementation that autowires annotated fields, setter methods, and arbitrary config methods.
items.translation: BeanPostProcessor 实现，用于自动装配带注解的字段、setter 方法和任意配置方法。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor implementation that invokes annotated init and destroy methods.
items.translation: 实现 `BeanPostProcessor` 接口以调用已注解的初始化方法和销毁方法。

items.source: Subinterface of BeanPostProcessor that adds a before-destruction callback.
items.translation: 为 `BeanPostProcessor` 接口添加销毁前回调的子接口。

items.source: Subinterface of BeanPostProcessor that adds a before-instantiation callback, and a callback after instantiation but before explicit properties are set or autowiring occurs.
items.translation: `BeanPostProcessor` 接口的子接口，用于添加实例化前的回调，以及在实例化后但在显式设置属性或自动装配发生之前的回调。

items.source: Extension of the InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor interface, adding a callback for predicting the eventual type of a processed bean.
items.translation: `InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor` 接口的扩展，添加了用于预测已处理 Bean 最终类型的回调。

items.source: Simple BeanPostProcessor that checks JSR-303 constraint annotations in Spring-managed beans, throwing an initialization exception in case of constraint violations right before calling the bean's init method (if any).
items.translation: 简单的 BeanPostProcessor，用于检查 Spring 托管 Bean 中的 JSR-303 约束注解。如果在调用 Bean 的初始化方法（如果有）之前发现约束违规，则抛出初始化异常。

items.source: A convenient BeanPostProcessor implementation that delegates to a JSR-303 provider for performing method-level validation on annotated methods.
items.translation: 一个方便的BeanPostProcessor实现，它委托给 JSR-303 提供者以在已注解的方法上执行方法级验证。

items.translation: `org.springframework.aop.aspectj.annotation` 中 `BeanPostProcessor` 的用法

items.translation: BeanPostProcessor 在 org.springframework.aop.aspectj.autoproxy 中的用法

items.translation: `org.springframework.context.annotation` 中 `BeanPostProcessor` 的用法

items.translation: `org.springframework.context.weaving` 中 `BeanPostProcessor` 的用法

items.translation: 在 `org.springframework.dao.annotation` 包中对 `BeanPostProcessor` 的用法

items.source: Uses of BeanPostProcessor in org.springframework.jms.annotation
items.translation: 在 `org.springframework.jms.annotation` 包中 `BeanPostProcessor` 的用法

items.translation: `org.springframework.orm.jpa.support` 中 `BeanPostProcessor` 的用法

items.translation: `org.springframework.resilience.annotation` 中 `BeanPostProcessor` 的用法

items.source: Uses of BeanPostProcessor in org.springframework.scheduling.annotation
items.translation: 在 `org.springframework.scheduling.annotation` 包中 `BeanPostProcessor` 的用法

items.source: Uses of BeanPostProcessor in org.springframework.scripting.support
items.translation: `org.springframework.scripting.support` 中 `BeanPostProcessor` 的用法

items.source: Uses of BeanPostProcessor in org.springframework.validation.beanvalidation
items.translation: `org.springframework.validation.beanvalidation` 中 `BeanPostProcessor` 的用法

items.source: Uses of BeanPostProcessor in org.springframework.web.context.support
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.context.support` 中 `BeanPostProcessor` 的用法

items.source: Uses of BeanPostProcessor in org.springframework.web.servlet.handler
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.servlet.handler` 包中 `BeanPostProcessor` 的用法

items.source: Bean post-processor that automatically applies persistence exception translation to any bean marked with Spring's @Repository annotation, adding a corresponding PersistenceExceptionTranslationAdvisor to the exposed proxy (either an existing AOP proxy or a newly generated proxy that implements all of the target's interfaces).
items.translation: 自动将持久化异常转换应用于任何标记有 Spring 的 `@Repository` 注解的 bean 的 Bean 后处理器，向暴露的代理（现有的 AOP 代理或新生成的实现目标所有接口的代理）添加相应的 `PersistenceExceptionTranslationAdvisor`。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor that processes PersistenceUnit and PersistenceContext annotations, for injection of the corresponding JPA resources EntityManagerFactory and EntityManager.
items.translation: 处理 `PersistenceUnit` 和 `PersistenceContext` 注解的 BeanPostProcessor，用于注入相应的 JPA 资源 `EntityManagerFactory` 和 `EntityManager`。

items.source: Bean post-processor that automatically applies asynchronous invocation behavior to any bean that carries the Async annotation at class or method-level by adding a corresponding AsyncAnnotationAdvisor to the exposed proxy (either an existing AOP proxy or a newly generated proxy that implements all the target's interfaces).
items.translation: 自动将异步调用行为应用于任何在类或方法级别携带 Async 注解的 Bean 的后处理器，通过向暴露的代理（现有的 AOP 代理或新生成的实现目标所有接口的代理）添加相应的 AsyncAnnotationAdvisor。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor implementation that creates AOP proxies based on all candidate Advisors in the current BeanFactory.
items.translation: 实现 `BeanPostProcessor` 的代理，基于当前 `BeanFactory` 中的所有候选 `Advisor` 创建 AOP 代理。

items.source: Load-time weaving support for a Spring application context, building on Spring's LoadTimeWeaver abstraction.
items.translation: 支持 Spring 应用程序上下文的加载时织入，基于 Spring 的 LoadTimeWeaver 抽象。

items.source: Package containing Spring's basic AOP infrastructure, compliant with the AOP Alliance interfaces.
items.translation: 包含 Spring 基本 AOP 基础架构的包，符合 AOP Alliance 接口。

items.source: Classes supporting the org.springframework.beans.factory package.
items.translation: 支持org.springframework.beans.factory包的类。

items.source: Classes supporting the org.springframework.orm.jpa package.
items.translation: 支持org.springframework.orm.jpa包的类。

items.source: Classes supporting the org.springframework.web.context package, such as WebApplicationContext implementations and various utility classes.
items.translation: 支持org.springframework.web.context包的类，例如 WebApplicationContext 实现和各种实用工具类。

items.source: Post-processor callback interface for merged bean definitions at runtime.
items.translation: 运行时mergedBean 定义的后处理器回调接口。

items.source: Classes enabling AspectJ 5 @Annotated classes to be used in Spring AOP.
items.translation: 使 AspectJ 5 @Annotated 类能够在 Spring AOP 中使用的类。

items.source: Base classes enabling auto-proxying based on AspectJ.
items.translation: 基于 AspectJ 实现自动代理的基础类。

items.source: SPI package allowing Spring AOP framework to handle arbitrary advice types.
items.translation: 允许 Spring AOP 框架处理任意通知类型的 SPI 包。

items.source:
Bean post-processors for use in ApplicationContexts to simplify AOP usage
by automatically creating AOP proxies without the need to use a ProxyFactoryBean.
items.translation: 用于 ApplicationContext 的 Bean 后置处理器，可简化 AOP 的使用，通过自动创建 AOP 代理而无需使用 ProxyFactoryBean。

items.source: Support package for annotation-driven bean configuration.
items.translation: 用于注解驱动的 Bean 配置的辅助包。

items.source: SPI interfaces and configuration-related convenience classes for bean factories.
items.translation: 用于 Bean 工厂的 SPI 接口和与配置相关的便捷类。

items.source:
Annotation support for the Application Context, including JSR-250 "common"
annotations, component-scanning, and Java-based metadata for creating
Spring-managed objects.
items.translation: 支持应用上下文的注解，包括 JSR-250“通用”注解、组件扫描以及用于创建 Spring 托管对象的基于 Java 的元数据。

items.source: Annotation support for DAOs.
items.translation: 支持 DAO 的注解。

items.source: Annotations and support classes for declarative JMS listener endpoints.
items.translation: 用于声明式 JMS 监听器端点的注解和支持类。

items.source: Annotation-based retry and concurrency limit support.
items.translation: 基于注解的重试和并发限制支持。

items.source: Annotation support for asynchronous method execution.
items.translation: 支持异步方法执行的注解。

items.source: Support classes for Spring's scripting package.
items.translation: Spring 脚本包的支持类。

items.source:
Support classes for integrating a JSR-303 Bean Validation provider
(such as Hibernate Validator) into a Spring ApplicationContext
and in particular with Spring's data binding and validation APIs.
items.translation: 支持将 JSR-303 Bean Validation 提供者（例如 Hibernate Validator）集成到 Spring ApplicationContext 中的辅助类，特别是与 Spring 的数据绑定和验证 API 一起使用。

items.source:
Provides standard HandlerMapping implementations,
including abstract base classes for custom implementations.
items.translation: 提供标准的 HandlerMapping 实现，包括用于自定义实现的抽象基类。

items.source:
Generic auto proxy creator that builds AOP proxies for specific beans
based on detected Advisors for each bean.
items.translation: 通用自动代理创建器，它根据每个 Bean 检测到的 Advisor 为特定 Bean 构建 AOP 代理。

items.source: Auto proxy creator that identifies beans to proxy via a list of names.
items.translation: 自动代理创建器，通过名称列表来识别需要代理的 Bean。

items.source:
Auto-proxy creator that considers infrastructure Advisor beans only,
ignoring any application-defined Advisors.
items.translation: 仅考虑基础设施 Advisor 的自动代理创建器，忽略任何应用程序定义的 Advisor。

items.source:
Add a new BeanPostProcessor that will get applied to beans created
by this factory.
items.translation: 添加一个新的 BeanPostProcessor，该处理器将应用于此工厂创建的 Bean。

items.source:
Return the list of BeanPostProcessors that will get applied
to beans created with this factory.
items.translation: 返回将应用于通过此工厂创建的 Bean 的 BeanPostProcessor 列表。

items.source:
Add new BeanPostProcessors that will get applied to beans created
by this factory.
items.translation: 添加新的 BeanPostProcessor，这些处理器将应用于此工厂创建的 Bean。
